title: Vertical Benchmarking Signals Synthesis & Scenario Cadence
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Objective: build a repeatable, verticalized benchmarking and signal-synthesis process to track competitive model behavior and commercial risk across three pilot verticals (FinServ, Healthcare SaaS, and E‑commerce search). The output will be (1) a prioritized benchmark matrix that maps model flavors and quantization variants to vertical success metrics (latency, failure modes, hallucination rate on vertical prompts, token cost), (2) a weekly signal cadence (short-form snapshot + one deep-dive per month) for stakeholders, and (3) instrumentation requirements and a prototype dashboard for Console/Signals team to operationalize.

Scope: design signal schema, assemble vertical prompt sets (seeded from customer interviews + anonymized telemetry), run synthetic load + edge-case probes across targeted models, synthesize latency/econ/quality tradeoffs, recommend routing & fallback priorities for each vertical. Work includes cross-team coordination with Research (prompt design), Eng (bench runner + metrics), Console (dashboard prototype), and GTM (customer pain validation).

Success criteria (measurable):
- Completed benchmark matrix covering ≥6 model variants across 3 verticals with per-metric deltas (latency, median RPS, cost per 1k tokens, top-1 hallucination rate) by 2026-04-10.
- Weekly signal snapshot (one-page) delivered to Signals Slack channel every Friday for 6 weeks.
- Prototype dashboard with filters for vertical/model/region and a drilldown to representative failing prompts delivered to Console team for handoff by due date.
- Clear recommendations (A/B ranked) for routing/fallback policies per vertical (latency-first, cost-first, quality-first) with expected cost/latency delta estimates.

Out-of-scope: full enterprise rollout, private deployment automation, or contractual pricing changes — those will be separate follow-ups once pilot proves signal value.

Data sources & artifacts:
- Vertical prompt bank (Drive): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/example-vertical-prompts
- Confluence PRD / signal spec: https://confluence.redwood.example/display/SIG/Vertical+Benchmarking+PRD
- Benchmark runner repo (prototype): https://github.com/redwood-inference/bench-runner/pull/312
- Internal prototype dashboard (Looker / Console staging): https://dashboards.redwood.example/s/vertical-signals-proto
comments: 2026-03-02 — Kickoff: aligned pilot verticals with Research and Solutions. Action: Research to deliver seed prompt sets (due 2026-03-08).

2026-03-05 — Decision: use a two-layer signal: weekly short snapshot (top 6 metrics) + monthly deep-dive (failure-mode taxonomy). Rationale: weekly keeps GTM informed with low overhead; monthly surfaces systemic risks.
2026-03-07 — Trade-off discussion with Eng: full-tokenized costs vs estimated token counts. Agreed to run both for initial 6 models and then prune to cost-estimate only for routine cadence.
2026-03-09 — Research delivered seed prompts; early note: FinServ seed contains many numerical-context prompts that amplify hallucination risk. Action: Eng to add numeric-stability test harness.
2026-03-10 — PR opened for bench-runner to add vertical tagging and per-prompt metadata: https://github.com/redwood-inference/bench-runner/pull/312 — awaiting Eng review.
acceptance_criteria: Benchmark matrix CSV uploaded to Drive with clear column definitions and data dictionary.
Weekly snapshot template created and approved by GTM and Product leadership.
Console prototype link works and has basic filters by vertical/model/region.
Routing/fallback recommendation doc with quantified cost/latency tradeoffs for each vertical.
